 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/CRIMINAL MISC.APPLICATION NO. 3025 of 2024  (FOR REGULAR BAIL - AFTER CHARGESHEET)
=======================================================
 PANKAJKUMAR KARSANBHAI PATEL  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT =======================================================
Appearance:
MR HRIDAY BUCH(2372) for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MR LB DABHI APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 =======================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DIVYESH A. JOSHI  Date : 13/03/2024

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1. Rule.
Learned APP waives service of notice of rule for respondent - State of Gujarat.

2. The present application is filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for regular bail in connection with the FIR being C.R. No.11217041230159/2023 registered with the Saraswati Police Station, Patan for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 465, 467, 468, 471,
409, 120(B) and 201 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned advocate for the applicant submitted that the so-called incident has taken place for the period between 01.01.2019 to 23.06.2021, for which, the FIR has been lodged on 15.04.2023 and the applicant has been arrested in connection with the same on 19.01.2024 and since then, he is in judicial custody.

Learned advocate submitted that now the investigation is completed and after NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/3025/2024 ORDER DATED: 13/03/2024 undefined submission of the chargesheet, the present application is preferred.
Learned advocate submitted that there is inordinate and unexplained delay caused in filing aforesaid FIR.

Learned advocate submitted that Pankajkumar Karsanbhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55507796/
1 FIR has been filed against total 15 accused persons, wherein the applicant is shown as accused no.15.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned advocate submitted that it is alleged in the FIR that while performing duty as Divisional Inspector, the applicant has shown dereliction of duty on his part because without verifying the veracity and genuineness of the documents, the applicant has approved those documents and forwarded it to his higher officers and thereby committed alleged offence.

Learned advocate submitted that the applicant has not received single penny out of said transaction and there is no mechanism for verification of those set of documents and whatever documents produced before him by the concerned persons have been considered as true and genuine and except this, there is no other role attributed to him.
Learned advocate submitted that the co-accused, who is having identical role and/or grave role than the present applicant, has been considered by this Court.
Learned advocate submitted that all the offences are exclusively triable by the Court of Magistrate.

Learned advocate submitted that entire case of the prosecution hinges upon documentary evidence,
which have been collected by the IO during the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/3025/2024 ORDER DATED: 13/03/2024 undefined course of investigation and number of witnesses have been cited in the chargesheet and, hence, trial would get delayed.
It is, therefore, urged that considering the nature of the offence and on the ground of parity, the applicant may be enlarged on regular bail by imposing suitable conditions.
4. Learned APP for the respondent-State has opposed grant of regular bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.
It is submitted that the role of the present applicant is clearly spelt out from the papers of the chargesheet.

Learned APP submitted that in connivance with each other, the accused have committed alleged offences and thereby misappropriated huge volume of amount and the involvement of the present applicant is found out from the chargesheet papers.

Learned APP,
therefore, urged that the present application may not be entertained.
5. Learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties do not press for further reasoned order.

6. I have heard the learned advocates appearing on behalf of the respective parties and perused the papers of the investigation and considered the allegations levelled against the applicant and the role played by the applicant.

It is found out from the record that the present application is preferred after submission of the chargesheet and now the investigation is completed and the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/3025/2024 ORDER DATED: 13/03/2024 undefined applicant is in jail since 19.01.2024.
All the offences are exclusively triable by the Court of Magistrate.

The case of the prosecution hinges upon documentary evidence, which have been collected by the IO during the course of investigation and number of witnesses have been cited as witness in the chargesheet papers and because of which, trial will take considerable time to conclude.
I have considered the role attributed to the present applicant at the time of commission of crime and the role of the co- accused, who has been considered by this Court.
Therefore considering the above factual aspects and on the ground of parity, the present application deserves to be allowed.

7. This Court has also taken into consideration the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sanjay Chandra v. Central Bureau of Investigation, reported in [2012] 1 SCC 40 as well as in case of Satender Kumar Antil v. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr. reported in (2022) 10 SCC Pankajkumar Karsanbhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55507796/
2 51.
8.

sentences.text: In the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations made against the applicant in the FIR, without discussing the evidence in detail, prima facie, this Court is of the opinion that this is a fit case to exercise the discretion and enlarge the applicant on regular bail.
9. Hence, the present application is allowed.
The authorities will release the applicant only if he is not required in connection with any other offence for the time being.

If breach of any of the above conditions is committed, the concerned Sessions Judge concerned will be free to issue NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/3025/2024 ORDER DATED: 13/03/2024 undefined warrant or take appropriate action in the matter.
Bail bond to be executed before the lower Court having jurisdiction to try the case.
It will be open for the concerned Court to delete, modify and/or relax any of the above conditions, in accordance with law.
11. At the trial, the trial Court shall not be influenced by the observations of preliminary nature qua the evidence at this stage made by this Court while enlarging the applicant on bail.
12. Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
